serviceTimeMs.how: mean = Node's CPU per request at 3225 req/s net of idle: (19141 - 4 ms at rest) / 96752 requests = 0.1978 ms, less the 0.0003 ms per request of the pauses modelled as GC (gcPauseMs) = 0.1975 ms; shape (p95/median 0.0066/0.0034 ms) from the handler's own time

clientLinkLatencyMs.how: anchored: (measured median 0.571 ms - the model's median without it 0.630 ms at 3225 req/s) / 2, one way, at least 0

serviceTimeByLoad.how: the staircase's CPU per request net of idle (0.5933 ms at 50, 0.2006 ms at 1010, 0.2234 ms at 3225 req/s), fitted never rising with rate and divided by the top rate's (0.2234 ms); flat outside the staircase

gcPauseMs.how: V8's mark-compact cycles in the pass: 24.3 ms (incremental 14.6 ms, major 9.7 ms) over 2 cycles, a mean of 12.138 ms (the model's median: mean / 1.17); 85 scavenges, 126.3 ms, left in the CPU per request

gcEveryRequests.how: 96752 requests / 2 mark-compact cycles in the pass

writeServiceTimeMs.how: PostgreSQL's CPU per UPDATE with synchronous_commit off (0.1987 ms), shaped like its round trip (median 0.284, p95 4.212 ms)

readServiceTimeMs.how: PostgreSQL's CPU per SELECT (0.1859 ms, the pass's less its UPDATEs'), shaped like its round trip (median 0.281, p95 2.209 ms)

dbLinkLatencyMs.how: each way: the round trip the service measured less PostgreSQL's time, in two legs that keep its mean and variance (median 0.0553, p95 0.8331 ms)

dbCpuShare.how: PostgreSQL CPU per query at the top pass net of idle (0.1872 ms) / the model's mean time per query (87076 reads at 0.186 ms and 9676 writes without their flush at 0.199 ms: 0.187 ms)

commitFlushMs.how: PostgreSQL's own WAL flushes at 3225 req/s (pg_stat_wal): 9292 flushes of 1.015 ms on average, 1.04 commits per flush (the model: 1.04); shaped like the commit wait the service measured (p95/median 1.01, mean 1.111 ms)

serviceMemoryBaselineMb.how: at idle: the api container's working set (the highest reading in each pass) against req/s over 10 points (at rest and 9 passes, 50 to 3,225 req/s), by non-negative least squares: 24.8 MiB + 0.0358 MiB per req/s, largest error at and above the median rate 58%

serviceMemoryPerRpsMb.how: per req/s: the api container's working set (the highest reading in each pass) against req/s over 10 points (at rest and 9 passes, 50 to 3,225 req/s), by non-negative least squares: 24.8 MiB + 0.0358 MiB per req/s, largest error at and above the median rate 58%

serviceMemoryPerRequestMb.how: per request held: the floor, since the fit against req/s explains the whole working set (held requests' memory would count twice otherwise)
